## What this PR ships

This PR adds everything needed for Chronicle to **continuously learn and improve** — and for that growth to be visible to the whole team.

### Advisor — plain-language interface to Chronicle

Ask Chronicle a question in plain English:

\`\`\`
quorum advisor "what did we decide about authentication?"

  What we know
  The team settled on RS256 JWT after rejecting HS256 — key rotation without
  invalidating active sessions was the blocker.

  Recommendation
  Follow the RS25
